svg.text: Mazda flip key – blade head: points and edges (v3)
● F1, B6, U7… = points (corners and tips). [f1] [u7]… = edges. Single capital letters (A–Z) = measurements, listed at the bottom. Blade folded. Shapes approximate.
blade on the RIGHT · bottom edge points DOWN in the middle
blade on the LEFT · bottom edge points UP in the middle
3 SIDE — looking at the blade side
logo face on the LEFT · rivet face on the RIGHT
4 BOTTOM — held the way you hold it
bottom towards you · logo face DOWN · blade on the LEFT
dark = tab (hook = lighter, toward the blade) · dashed box = base
white channel = blade gap · grey = blade · dashed u7 = bottom centre line
Measurements as points and edges (check I've put each one in the right place)
F2 – F4 width where the dome starts
F1 – F5 width at the bottom corners
u1 – u5 thickness (S2 – S3 at the widest)
B3 → B6 dome tip to rivet-face centre
F3 → F1/F5 level dome tip to bottom corners
f7 → f10 base bottom to tab tip
F3 → f10 dome tip to tab tip
F12 – F13 tab width incl. hook
u6 → u18 blade-side edge to tab
u3 → u16 other edge to tab
u1 → u15 rivet face to tab
F5 → F18/F19 level corner to blade tip
f16 flush with f3 blade to blade-side edge
u1 → U11 line rivet face to blade
F3 → F6 dome tip to logo-face centre
F6 → f7 logo-face centre to base bottom
u6 → U13 blade-side edge to base
u1 → U13 rivet face to base
u6 → u9 how deep the blade gap goes in
S7/S8 → F3 level how far up the side the gap runs
* F: please confirm it was measured from the bottom of the base (edge f7), not from the head.
Anything without a label: describe it by the points/edges it sits between (e.g. "a step on f6, 2 mm below F7").
Positions of the base, tab and blade gap that are still unmeasured are drawn where I currently guess they are.
